opis: Navdih za nadnaravno serijo so bili Vampirski dnevniki. Zapeljiva nova serija govori o prvotni vampirski družini in nevarnem hibridu vampirja in volkodlaka Klausu Mikaelsonu, ki se vrne v New Orleans, mesto, ki ga je pred stoletji pomagal zgraditi.
reziser: Michael A. Allowitz, Lance Anderson, Carol Banker
igralci: Joseph Morgan (Klaus Mikaelson), Daniel Gillies (Elijah Mikaelson), Claire Holt (Rebekah Mikaelson), Phoebe Tonkin (Hayley Marshall), Phoebe Tonkin (Hayley Marshall-Kenner), Charles Michael Davis (Marcel Gerard), Yusuf Gatewood (Vincent Griffith), Yusuf Gatewood (Finn Mikaelson), Danielle Campbell (Davina Claire), Leah Pipes (Camille OConnell), Riley Voelkel (Freya Mikaelson), Steven Krueger (Josh Rosza)
